workLog.action: Ran a SCOPED adr-review on the draft Amendment 2026-08-12 to ADR-080: two independent reviewers, one round, given the artifact only and not the reasoning behind it. Critic lens covered contradiction with the Decision, citation accuracy, overstatement, and completeness. Contrarian lens steelmanned the opposite of every claim and argued supersede over amend. This is a deliberate deviation from the skill's 6-agent 10-round protocol, justified because the change corrects rationale and edits none of the six Decision rules, and it is recorded as a deviation rather than claimed as a full run.
